description: Codex CLI hook registration for ONEX capture (OMN-18704). Registers the SAME four bus-mirror entrypoints the Claude Code side uses, against the SAME local journal, with the actor declared on each command line. Codex 0.154.0 ships a native Claude-Code-shaped hooks surface: twelve event names, a field-compatible JSON input schema on stdin, and command strings run through a shell (so both an argv flag and an ONEX_HOOK_ACTOR= prefix work). This adds one producer to the existing pipeline -- it adds no daemon, no tailer and no transport. Deliberately narrow: only the four emitters, never the guard hooks, because a guard written against Claude Code's tool vocabulary has no meaning under a different host's tool names. The `notify` config key is NOT used: it is occupied by the ChatGPT computer-use client and fires at turn boundaries only, which cannot carry per-tool-call events.
